title: Team Incentives, Social Cohesion, and Performance: A Natural Field Experiment
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with one treatment window (weeks 42-47 of 2013) common to all treated stores. Single adoption date, no staggering.
design_notes: Eq. (1): g_sw = alpha_s + gamma_w + beta*T_sw + eps, store and week FE, SEs clustered by store; T_sw=1 for treatment stores during weeks 42-47 only (switches off after). Outcome is weekly sales growth vs same week of previous year. Table 4 col (1): ATE 1.5 pp (not significant), 5,722 store-week obs. Eq. (2) adds T x social cohesion (continuous interaction) and E x C (all stores x experimental period x cohesion). Employee-level survey regression (Eq. 3) uses individual and questionnaire FE with two survey waves. Published in MS 68(1):230-256 (2022).
estimators_reported: TWFE (store and week FE) in a randomized two-group design

ineligible_specs.reason: single common treatment start/end; continuous interaction with social cohesion in cols (2)-(4); two-wave survey panel

screener_notes: Field experiment in a Dutch retail chain of 122 stores; store-level sales data and employee surveys come from the firm (company administrative data, not public). No data-availability statement in the text. Cites Bertrand-Duflo-Mullainathan for clustering only.
